_note: v2.4 plan 02 step 2, row 'swallowed settings save' (H15, T8). No backend. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v24-02-settings-save-swallowed.json --sandbox --group 1759606632088. H15, re-verified 2026-09-24: saveSettings (script.js:8051-8115) never rejects. It defers silently while settings are not ready (:8052-8055), POSTs /api/settings/save, throws on !ok into its own catch, which only logs and toasts (:8111-8114), and emits SETTINGS_UPDATED only after a 2xx (:8110). Our library writes go through saveSettingsDebounced (storyLibrary.ts:110 saveStoryRecord, script.js:470), so nothing we call can see the failure. The fixture opens the Studio on the sandbox story, edits the draft description, blocks /api/settings/save with a 500 at the transport, and saves from the Studio toolbar. After the debounce has fired, the toolbar's own sentence is read and the route unblocked; the fixture then removes the edited record from the library by id (its hash changed, so the runner's hash-scoped cleanup would not), closes the Studio, and only then asserts. Asserts: the toolbar does NOT claim 'Saved "X" vN to the library.' while the settings save answered 500, and instead says the save is not confirmed (plan 02 section 7: the claim only on evidence, otherwise 'Saving "X" vN... not confirmed'). EXPECTED RED on today's code: StudioToolbar sets the success sentence straight after saveStoryRecord returns (StudioToolbar.tsx:32, :63), with no evidence of the settings write.

requires.why: #so-open-studio shows only with no story or in Author view (EntryPoints.tsx:114, 544975fb); the fixture opens the Studio on the sandbox story

[]).map((r) => r.id) }; return globalThis.__v24H15;

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; globalThis.__v24H15.removed = await rt.removeStory(globalThis.__v24H15.storyId); const studioSaved = (SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.v2Stories ??
